about: CP-MVP-010 S10 — the retrieval evaluation set. Each case is a question a person would actually ask this vault, with the notes that ANSWER it. `expect` is what must appear in the packet; `reject` is what must not. Reach defaults to `linked`. Bedrock 33 §Evaluation gates: this is the baseline any heavier stage (stemming, embeddings, a parser) has to beat, with numbers.

cases.why: the plainest case: a note titled after the word
the vault writes crédibilité; the question does not

cases.query: Que peux tu me dire de Plato ?
cases.why: the subject is what is rare; the politeness ranks nothing
the transcript is titled after the question and must not answer it
schema never says xml: the typed edge is what brings it
repose-sur, walked from the title match
a quoted phrase is a filter, not a bonus
the hub mentions it in passing and links twelve notes: being listed by it is not relevance

reject: prompts/Explain me like I am 5 years old.md
cases.why: a prompt file is instructions to the model, never knowledge
a source's derived text is ordinary retrievable knowledge
a project bundle is a perimeter
the vault says nothing: the packet must say so, which is what CP-MVP-011 branches on
a heading the app writes into every index answers nothing
